mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear 63 degrees near Verona Community Park. You might want to look up at 10:22 PM, as the International Space Station will be visible, rising in the northwest over Cross Plains and traveling toward the southeast near Oregon, reaching about halfway up the sky. The moon is in its first quarter phase, and tonight's low will be 53 degrees with no rain predicted.

The city wants to remind you that you can stay connected through the Verona Cable Channel, VHAT, which broadcasts city meetings and community programming. You can also visit the city website to subscribe to their digital newsletter for updates on local projects and programs.

There is a lot happening in our community. Today, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's, attend a yoga session at Insight Wellness, enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, grab a slice during Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Louie, or test your knowledge at Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, tomorrow features Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and trivia night at Hop Haus Brewing.

Regarding the weekly police report, on July 14, an officer conducted a traffic stop for a vehicle operating without headlights. The driver was cited for possession of marijuana and drug paraphernalia, and it was discovered they did not possess a concealed carry permit.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. Please note that the store is currently closed, but they will reopen tomorrow at 10:00 AM, when the flavor will be Really Reese's.
